Author: Brad Wilcox
Message:
LKID-72: feat(observability) — Sentry frontend + backend integration (#55)

* feat(observability): wire Sentry on the Next.js frontend (LKID-72)

Installs `@sentry/nextjs` v10 and configures client / server / edge runtimes
per the current Next.js 15+ convention (`instrumentation-client.ts` +
`instrumentation.ts` dispatcher). `withSentryConfig` wraps `next.config.ts`
so source maps upload during Vercel build when SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN is set.

Key policy decisions:
- Session replay OFF — privacy-conservative default for a health-adjacent app.
- Tracing sample rate 10% in production (100% in dev).
- `beforeSend` scrubs `/results|/gate|/reports/<token>` from URLs +
  breadcrumb messages/data so LKID-62 MED-01 bearer tokens never land in
  Sentry payloads.
- Added `app/src/app/global-error.tsx` so React render-tree errors that
  escape the root layout still reach Sentry via `captureException`.
- `onRequestError = Sentry.captureRequestError` exported from
  `instrumentation.ts` to catch Server Component + proxy errors.

Env vars required on Vercel (Brad to set):
  NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN, SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, SENTRY_ORG, SENTRY_PROJECT.

Absent a DSN the SDK is a silent no-op so local dev keeps working.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(observability): wire Sentry on the FastAPI backend (LKID-72)

Adds `sentry-sdk[fastapi]>=2.0` and initialises Sentry before the
FastAPI app is constructed so the FastApi / Sqlalchemy / Asyncio
integrations can hook the framework at import time. The built-in
`logging` integration auto-routes every existing `logger.exception(...)`
in `main.py` and `services/*.py` to Sentry — no redundant
`sentry_sdk.capture_exception()` calls required.

`sentry_scrubber.scrub_report_token` is wired as the `before_send` hook
and walks `request.{url,query_string,data}`,
`exception.values[*].value`, `breadcrumbs.values[*].{message,data}`,
`logentry.{message,formatted,params}`, and `extra` / `tags`, redacting
every occurrence of `/results|/gate|/reports/<token>` bearer paths.
LKID-62 MED-01 compliance: report tokens are 256-bit bearer credentials
and must never land in Sentry logs.

Init is gated on SENTRY_DSN so the backend runs unchanged in local dev
when the env var is unset. Release tag is the Railway git SHA;
environment defaults to `production` when `RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT` is
absent.

Env var required on Railway (Brad to set): SENTRY_DSN.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(observability): cover `scrub_report_token` Sentry hook (LKID-72)

Six tests asserting the scrubber:
- Redacts tokens on `/results`, `/gate`, `/reports` paths.
- Preserves route prefix (`/results/[REDACTED]`) so Sentry grouping is
  still useful.
- Leaves unrelated short path ids and non-token routes untouched.
- Walks every well-known event subtree (request, exception, breadcrumbs,
  logentry, extra, tags) and leaves no token anywhere in the final event
  (asserted via `repr(scrubbed)` containment check — belt + braces).
- Tolerates empty events and missing subtrees without returning None
  (returning None would cause Sentry to drop the event entirely).
- Pins the exported regex pattern so a future refactor that silently
  widens/narrows the token match is caught loudly.

Author: Brad Wilcox
Message:
LKID-62: Backend — no-auth tokenized flow (predict + results + leads + pdf) (#35)

* chore(backend): add resend + klaviyo-api deps for LKID-62 tokenized flow

Pins resend==2.29.0 and klaviyo-api==23.0.0 for the LKID-62 no-auth
tokenized flow. Also adds pytest-asyncio for async test helpers on the
new endpoint suite. Env placeholders added for RESEND_API_KEY,
RESEND_FROM_EMAIL, PUBLIC_APP_URL, and KLAVIYO_PRIVATE_API_KEY.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(backend): add Resend + Klaviyo service wrappers for LKID-62

Two thin integration boundaries called from POST /leads:

- services/resend_service.py: `send_report_email()` — wraps the sync
  Resend SDK in asyncio.to_thread so the fire-and-forget task doesn't
  block the FastAPI loop. Never raises; returns True/False. Supports
  optional PDF attachment (omitted on PDF-render-failure fallback).

- services/klaviyo_service.py: `track_prediction_completed()` — single
  Events.create_event call that upserts the profile and fires the
  'Prediction Completed' metric, keyed by `pred_{prediction_id}` for
  idempotency. Never raises.

Both modules intentionally log no PII (HIPAA guard from
agents/yuri/drafts/hipaa-verification-notes.md).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(backend): rewire POST /predict + add tokenized endpoints (LKID-62)

Implements the backend half of the no-auth tokenized flow. The legacy
/predict page keeps working because Pydantic v2 silently drops extra
fields, so the old `{name, email, ...}` payload still validates.

Changes to POST /predict:
- Drops `name` and `email` from PredictRequest (Jira AC).
- Removes the LKID-11 fire-and-forget _write_lead() path.
- Generates `report_token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)` (256 bits).
- INSERTs into `predictions` (inputs + result as JSONB); lead_id and
  email_sent_at stay NULL until POST /leads links them.
- Response is `{report_token, ...full_result}` — back-compat superset.
- Rate limit 10/min/IP preserved (slowapi keyed on IP now that email is
  no longer on this endpoint).

New endpoints:
- GET /results/{token} → 200 with captured flag + optional lead block;
  404 on unknown token, 410 on revoked.
- POST /leads → upserts lead on email, links predictions.lead_id,
  kicks off asyncio.create_task() for Resend PDF email + Klaviyo event.
  Returns immediately (200 {ok, captured, token}). Rate limit 5/min/IP.
- GET /reports/{token}/pdf → renders Playwright PDF for the stored
  prediction via /internal/chart/{token}?secret=..., streamed as
  `application/pdf`. 30s render timeout (504 on timeout).

Fire-and-forget pipeline in `_send_report_email_task`:
  render PDF → render HTML (fallback template on PDF failure, no
  attachment) → Resend send → mark email_sent_at on success → fire
  Klaviyo event (independent of Resend outcome). Wrapped in try/except
  so unhandled exceptions become visible log lines instead of silent
  Python warnings.

Legacy POST /predict/pdf and POST /webhooks/clerk are untouched —
LKID-66 owns the eventual cleanup.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(backend): LKID-62 integration tests — 17 cases, all 4 endpoints

Covers POST /predict + GET /results/{token} + POST /leads +
GET /reports/{token}/pdf, with asserts on token shape, DB wiring, the
fire-and-forget Resend/Klaviyo pipeline, and error semantics
(404/410/valid).

Uses an in-memory FakeStore / _FakeSession pair that mirrors the
SQLAlchemy Result shape our handlers touch (.mappings().first()), so
no Postgres dependency. Matches the conftest pattern of factory-based
fixtures used elsewhere in backend/tests/.

All 17 tests pass. Full suite: 197 passed in 0.97s.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(backend): address PR #35 QA findings — HIGH-01 / MED-01 / MED-02 / MED-03

Yuri's PR #35 QA returned block-for-fix with 1 HIGH + 3 MED. All four
findings addressed in place on the same branch.

HIGH-01 — 504 on Playwright timeout is dead code (main.py:908-915 orig).
Playwright's own TimeoutError is NOT a subclass of asyncio.TimeoutError,
so a real 30s render timeout previously returned 500 instead of the
AC-required 504. Now catches both in a tuple, with a guarded import
(fallback sentinel class) for environments where playwright isn't
installed. New regression tests:
test_pdf_endpoint_timeout_returns_504 (asserts 504),
test_pdf_endpoint_generic_failure_returns_500 (guards against
over-broad timeout catching).

MED-01 — full report_token logged as bearer credential (6 sites).
Token is a bearer credential for /results/{token} and /reports/{token}/pdf
— logging it in full is equivalent to logging a password. Every log call
in main.py now logs either `prediction_id` (UUID, the preferred
identifier) or `token_prefix=<token[:8]>`. Multiline grep confirms all 6
Yuri-listed sites are resolved.

MED-02 — Klaviyo skipped when email-template render fails
(main.py:785-798 orig). The fire-and-forget task now has two independent
try/except blocks: the Resend pipeline (PDF + template + send + mark)
and the Klaviyo fire. Klaviyo fires REGARDLESS of Resend outcome so the
warm campaign captures every lead. Invariant preserved:
`email_sent_at` is still gated on Resend success. New tests:
test_klaviyo_fires_even_when_resend_fails,
test_klaviyo_fires_even_when_template_render_fails.

MED-03 — Resend attachment payload bloat (resend_service.py:82 orig).
Switched from `list(pdf_bytes)` (4-5x JSON bloat for real PDFs) to
`base64.b64encode(pdf_bytes).decode("ascii")`. Resend SDK v2.29's
Attachment TypedDict accepts `content: Union[List[int], str]` where the
string form is base64. New tests:
test_resend_attachment_is_base64 (decodes back to original bytes),
test_resend_no_attachment_when_pdf_bytes_none (fallback path).

Tests: 17 → 23 in test_new_flow_endpoints.py (+6), all 158 backend
tests pass (excluding pre-existing test_predictions_table.py
`python` vs `python3` env issue from PR #33, not in scope for this PR).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(backend): rewire POST /predict + add tokenized endpoints (LKID-62)

Implements the backend half of the no-auth tokenized flow. The legacy
/predict page keeps working because Pydantic v2 silently drops extra
fields, so the old `{name, email, ...}` payload still validates.

Changes to POST /predict:
- Drops `name` and `email` from PredictRequest (Jira AC).
- Removes the LKID-11 fire-and-forget _write_lead() path.
- Generates `report_token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)` (256 bits).
- INSERTs into `predictions` (inputs + result as JSONB); lead_id and
  email_sent_at stay NULL until POST /leads links them.
- Response is `{report_token, ...full_result}` — back-compat superset.
- Rate limit 10/min/IP preserved (slowapi keyed on IP now that email is
  no longer on this endpoint).

New endpoints:
- GET /results/{token} → 200 with captured flag + optional lead block;
  404 on unknown token, 410 on revoked.
- POST /leads → upserts lead on email, links predictions.lead_id,
  kicks off asyncio.create_task() for Resend PDF email + Klaviyo event.
  Returns immediately (200 {ok, captured, token}). Rate limit 5/min/IP.
- GET /reports/{token}/pdf → renders Playwright PDF for the stored
  prediction via /internal/chart/{token}?secret=..., streamed as
  `application/pdf`. 30s render timeout (504 on timeout).

Fire-and-forget pipeline in `_send_report_email_task`:
  render PDF → render HTML (fallback template on PDF failure, no
  attachment) → Resend send → mark email_sent_at on success → fire
  Klaviyo event (independent of Resend outcome). Wrapped in try/except
  so unhandled exceptions become visible log lines instead of silent
  Python warnings.

Legacy POST /predict/pdf and POST /webhooks/clerk are untouched —
LKID-66 owns the eventual cleanup.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(backend): LKID-62 integration tests — 17 cases, all 4 endpoints

Covers POST /predict + GET /results/{token} + POST /leads +
GET /reports/{token}/pdf, with asserts on token shape, DB wiring, the
fire-and-forget Resend/Klaviyo pipeline, and error semantics
(404/410/valid).

Uses an in-memory FakeStore / _FakeSession pair that mirrors the
SQLAlchemy Result shape our handlers touch (.mappings().first()), so
no Postgres dependency. Matches the conftest pattern of factory-based
fixtures used elsewhere in backend/tests/.

All 17 tests pass. Full suite: 197 passed in 0.97s.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(backend): address PR #35 QA findings — HIGH-01 / MED-01 / MED-02 / MED-03

Yuri's PR #35 QA returned block-for-fix with 1 HIGH + 3 MED. All four
findings addressed in place on the same branch.

HIGH-01 — 504 on Playwright timeout is dead code (main.py:908-915 orig).
Playwright's own TimeoutError is NOT a subclass of asyncio.TimeoutError,
so a real 30s render timeout previously returned 500 instead of the
AC-required 504. Now catches both in a tuple, with a guarded import
(fallback sentinel class) for environments where playwright isn't
installed. New regression tests:
test_pdf_endpoint_timeout_returns_504 (asserts 504),
test_pdf_endpoint_generic_failure_returns_500 (guards against
over-broad timeout catching).

MED-01 — full report_token logged as bearer credential (6 sites).
Token is a bearer credential for /results/{token} and /reports/{token}/pdf
— logging it in full is equivalent to logging a password. Every log call
in main.py now logs either `prediction_id` (UUID, the preferred
identifier) or `token_prefix=<token[:8]>`. Multiline grep confirms all 6
Yuri-listed sites are resolved.

MED-02 — Klaviyo skipped when email-template render fails
(main.py:785-798 orig). The fire-and-forget task now has two independent
try/except blocks: the Resend pipeline (PDF + template + send + mark)
and the Klaviyo fire. Klaviyo fires REGARDLESS of Resend outcome so the
warm campaign captures every lead. Invariant preserved:
`email_sent_at` is still gated on Resend success. New tests:
test_klaviyo_fires_even_when_resend_fails,
test_klaviyo_fires_even_when_template_render_fails.

MED-03 — Resend attachment payload bloat (resend_service.py:82 orig).
Switched from `list(pdf_bytes)` (4-5x JSON bloat for real PDFs) to
`base64.b64encode(pdf_bytes).decode("ascii")`. Resend SDK v2.29's
Attachment TypedDict accepts `content: Union[List[int], str]` where the
string form is base64. New tests:
test_resend_attachment_is_base64 (decodes back to original bytes),
test_resend_no_attachment_when_pdf_bytes_none (fallback path).

Tests: 17 → 23 in test_new_flow_endpoints.py (+6), all 158 backend
tests pass (excluding pre-existing test_predictions_table.py
`python` vs `python3` env issue from PR #33, not in scope for this PR).
